substances.name: Crystal Meth / Tik
substances.desc: Synthetic stimulant. Euphoria, no sleep, paranoia.
substances.hook: Floods brain with dopamine. Crash is brutal.
substances.step: Don't stop alone. Talk to a medical Pro + Addiction Counselor.

substances.name: Cocaine & Crack
substances.hook: Tricks brain into thinking you need it to feel normal.
substances.step: Tell someone you trust. Book a Rehab Assessment.

substances.name: Khat / Mairungi
substances.hook: Makes you talkative, kills appetite.
substances.step: Track chewing days. Swap with water + walk.

substances.name: Energy Drinks / High-Caffeine
substances.hook: Fake energy, then anxiety and sleep problems.
substances.step: Cut to 1 per day. Replace with water + sleep.

substances.name: Heroin / Nyaope / Whoonga
substances.hook: Numbs pain fast. Body dependent in days. OD risk high.
substances.step: Medical emergency. Call Pro for Rehab Assessment. Never quit cold turkey.

substances.name: Cough Syrup / Codeine / Lean
substances.hook: Legal but addictive. Damages liver.
substances.step: Count bottles per week. Tell GP. Taper with medical help.

substances.name: Benzos / Valium / Sedatives
substances.hook: Feels like "off switch" for stress. Dangerous with alcohol.
substances.step: Don't mix with alcohol. See Doctor for safe taper.

substances.name: Inhalants / Glue / Petrol
substances.hook: Cheap, fast high but causes brain damage and death.
substances.step: Remove access. Urgent help from counselor + medical Pro.

substances.name: Alcohol & Spirits
substances.desc: Beer, wine, chibuku, spirits. Depresses brain.
substances.hook: Social, legal, numbs stress. Body needs more.
substances.step: Track "dry days". If shakes without it, see Doctor.

substances.name: Cannabis / Mbanje / Weed
substances.desc: Smoked or eaten. Calm or anxiety/psychosis.
substances.hook: Relaxing but kills motivation with daily use.
substances.step: Try 7 days off. Talk to counselor if hard.

substances.name: Vaping & E-Cigarettes
substances.desc: Nicotine salts and flavors. More addictive than cigarettes.
substances.hook: Designed to be more addictive. Hides in pocket.
substances.step: Count pods per week. Switch to nicotine gum with Doctor.

substances.name: Tobacco / Cigarettes / Shisha
substances.hook: Nicotine withdrawal makes you crave every 1-2 hours.
substances.step: Pick quit date. Use patches/gum. Tell friends.

substances.name: Psychedelics / Mushrooms / LSD
substances.desc: Change perception and thinking for hours.
substances.hook: Can feel spiritual but triggers anxiety and psychosis.
substances.step: Don't use alone. If bad thoughts, seek medical help.

substances.name: Sugar / Ultra-Processed Foods
substances.desc: Chips, sweets, fast food. Impossible to stop at 1.
substances.hook: Sugar spikes dopamine like drugs. Crashes and cravings.
substances.step: Track 3 days of eating. Swap 1 snack for fruit/nuts.

substances.name: OTC Painkillers / Supplements
substances.hook: Damages organs over time.
substances.step: Never exceed dose. Ask pharmacist for safer options.

substances.name: Prescription Stimulants
substances.hook: Focus + energy. Can lead to dependency.
substances.step: See Doctor. Get proper assessment.

substances.name: Steroids
substances.hook: Feeds body dysmorphia.
substances.step: Gym trainer + Doctor.

substances.name: Nitrous Oxide / Whippets
substances.hook: Cheap and accessible.
substances.step: Stop — brain damage risk.

substances.name: Kratom
substances.hook: Can cause dependency.
substances.step: Taper with Pro.

substances.name: Hallucinogens (PCP etc)
substances.hook: Psychiatric risk.
substances.step: Psychiatric help.

substances.name: Club Drugs (Ecstasy, GHB)
substances.hook: Social scene. Risk of OD.
substances.step: Medical help if sick.

substances.name: Synthetic Cannabinoids (K2, Spice)
substances.hook: Unpredictable effects.
substances.step: ER if sick.

substances.name: GAS / Petrol Sniffing
substances.hook: Cheap and accessible.
substances.step: Urgent help.

substances.name: Betel Nut
substances.hook: Socially accepted.
substances.step: Track use. Talk to Pro.

substances.name: Other Substance
substances.hook: Unknown risks.
substances.step: Talk to Pro.

conditioning.name: Social Media / TikTok / IG / FB
conditioning.hook: Every scroll gives dopamine. Real life feels boring.
conditioning.step: Set 1hr daily limit. Delete app on weekends.

conditioning.name: Algorithmic Rage-Bait
conditioning.desc: News and videos designed to make you angry.
conditioning.hook: Anger = energy = more scrolling. Warps worldview.
conditioning.step: Mute angry accounts. Follow calm pages.

conditioning.name: Online Gaming / Loot Boxes
conditioning.desc: Games with rewards, ranks, gambling-style purchases.
conditioning.hook: Brain loves "level up". Can take 6+ hours.
conditioning.step: Set timer. No gaming before duties done.

conditioning.name: Pornography
conditioning.desc: Sexual content on phone. Free and private.
conditioning.hook: Huge dopamine hit. Real relationships feel dull.
conditioning.step: Use app blockers. Talk to same-gender counselor.

conditioning.name: Dating & Hookup Apps
conditioning.step: Limit to 20min/day. Meet in public only.

conditioning.name: Impulse E-Commerce / Temu / Shein
conditioning.desc: Shopping apps with endless cheap stuff.
conditioning.hook: Buying gives rush. Parcels = dopamine. Debt.
conditioning.step: 24hr wait rule before buying. Uninstall app.

conditioning.name: Gambling & Sports Betting
conditioning.desc: Bet on sports with Ecocash. "House always wins".
conditioning.hook: "Near miss" feels like you almost won. Chasing losses.
conditioning.step: Self-exclude. Give Ecocash to trusted person for 30 days.

conditioning.name: Forex & Crypto Trading
conditioning.desc: Apps marketed as "investment". Work like gambling.
conditioning.hook: Promise of "get rich". You lose to "gurus".
conditioning.step: Stop paying for signals. Only invest what you can lose.

conditioning.name: Television / Reality TV / Drama
conditioning.desc: Shows that normalize substances and violence.
conditioning.step: 1 show per night max. No TV in bedroom.

conditioning.name: Radio / Music Ads
conditioning.desc: Alcohol and betting ads between songs.

conditioning.name: Music as Conditioning
conditioning.desc: Songs that glorify drugs, money, violence.
conditioning.hook: You memorize it. Shapes what you think is "cool".
conditioning.step: Make playlist of positive music for 7 days.

conditioning.name: Other Conditioning
conditioning.desc: Anything else you scroll/watch that controls you.
conditioning.hook: If you can't stop, it's conditioning you.
conditioning.step: Name it. Track time. Talk to someone.

mental_health.name: Depression
mental_health.desc: Empty, no motivation for 2+ weeks.
mental_health.step: Talk to someone today. Book counselor. Move body 10min.

mental_health.name: Bipolar Disorder
mental_health.desc: High energy/mania weeks, then deep depression.
mental_health.hook: Mania feels good so you skip treatment.

mental_health.name: Persistent Depressive Disorder
mental_health.desc: Low mood most days for 2+ years.
mental_health.step: Therapy + possible medication. You can feel better.

mental_health.name: Seasonal Affective Disorder
mental_health.desc: Depression that comes in certain months.

mental_health.name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
mental_health.desc: Worry about everything all day for 6+ months.
mental_health.step: Breathing + CBT. Counselor can teach tools.

mental_health.name: Social Anxiety Disorder
mental_health.desc: Extreme fear of being judged or embarrassed.
mental_health.step: Start small. Therapist can do exposure work.

mental_health.name: Panic Disorder
mental_health.desc: Sudden heart racing, can't breathe, fear of dying.
mental_health.hook: Fear of next attack causes more panic.
mental_health.step: Learn ground technique. See Doctor to rule out heart.

mental_health.name: Phobias
mental_health.desc: Extreme fear of 1 thing: heights, spiders, etc.
mental_health.step: Therapist can help face it slowly.

mental_health.name: Agoraphobia
mental_health.desc: Fear of leaving home or crowds.

mental_health.name: PTSD
mental_health.desc: Flashbacks/nightmares after trauma. Always on edge.

mental_health.name: Complex PTSD
mental_health.desc: From long-term trauma like abuse. Numb + relationship issues.
mental_health.hook: Affects how you see self and others.
mental_health.step: Long-term therapy. You are not broken.

mental_health.name: Acute Stress Disorder
mental_health.desc: Shock symptoms in first month after trauma.

mental_health.name: Adjustment Disorder
mental_health.desc: Too much stress reaction to life change.

mental_health.name: Grief and Bereavement
mental_health.desc: Deep sadness after loss.
mental_health.step: Talk about them. Grief group helps.

mental_health.name: Non-Suicidal Self-Injury
mental_health.desc: Hurting self to feel relief: cutting, burning.
mental_health.hook: Pain gives brief control when emotions are big.
mental_health.step: Tell trusted adult NOW. Therapist + safety plan.

mental_health.name: Suicidal Ideation
mental_health.desc: Thoughts of "better off gone".
mental_health.hook: Depression lies and says there's no way out.
mental_health.step: TALK NOW. Call 999 or 116. You are not alone.

mental_health.name: Suicide Attempt
mental_health.desc: Tried to end life.
mental_health.step: Medical help NOW. Then therapy. You deserve to live.

mental_health.name: Anorexia Nervosa
mental_health.desc: Extreme fear of weight. Starving self.
mental_health.hook: Feels like control when life is chaos.

mental_health.name: Bulimia Nervosa
mental_health.desc: Binge eat then purge with vomit/laxatives.
mental_health.hook: Shame cycle. Damages teeth and heart.

mental_health.name: Binge Eating Disorder
mental_health.desc: Eating large amounts, can't stop, then guilt.
mental_health.step: Therapist + regular meals. Not about willpower.

mental_health.name: ARFID
mental_health.desc: Fear of food texture/taste. Very limited diet.
mental_health.hook: Not about weight. About sensory fear.

mental_health.name: Orthorexia
mental_health.desc: Obsession with "clean" eating only.

mental_health.name: ADHD
mental_health.desc: Brain struggles with focus, sitting still, finishing.
mental_health.step: Assessment. Tools + meds can help a lot.

mental_health.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
mental_health.desc: Brain processes social and sensory info differently.
mental_health.hook: World can feel loud and confusing.

mental_health.name: Learning Disorders
mental_health.desc: Brain struggles with reading, math despite effort.

mental_health.name: Intellectual Disability
mental_health.desc: Brain needs more support to learn daily skills.

mental_health.name: OCD
mental_health.desc: Intrusive thoughts + rituals to feel safe.
mental_health.hook: Ritual gives 5min relief but makes it worse.

mental_health.name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD)
mental_health.desc: Obsessed that 1 body part is ugly.

mental_health.name: Hoarding Disorder
mental_health.desc: Can't throw things away. Home gets blocked.

mental_health.name: Trichotillomania
mental_health.desc: Pulling hair out when stressed.

mental_health.name: Excoriation Disorder
mental_health.desc: Picking skin until it bleeds.

mental_health.name: Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
mental_health.desc: Intense emotions, fear of abandonment.
mental_health.hook: Relationships feel like life or death.
mental_health.step: DBT therapy. It helps a lot.

mental_health.name: Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD)
mental_health.desc: Need admiration, lack empathy.

mental_health.name: Antisocial Personality Disorder
mental_health.desc: Break rules, no remorse.

mental_health.name: Avoidant Personality Disorder
mental_health.desc: Extreme shyness, fear rejection.

mental_health.name: Schizophrenia
mental_health.desc: Hearing voices, delusions for 6+ months.

mental_health.name: Schizoaffective Disorder
mental_health.desc: Schizophrenia + mood disorder together.

mental_health.name: Brief Psychotic Disorder
mental_health.desc: Sudden psychosis after stress, lasts <1 month.

mental_health.name: Substance-Induced Psychosis
mental_health.desc: Drugs cause hallucinations/paranoia.

mental_health.name: Somatic Symptom Disorder
mental_health.desc: Body pain but no medical cause.

mental_health.name: Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID)
mental_health.desc: Multiple "parts".

mental_health.name: Depersonalization/Derealization
mental_health.desc: Feel unreal or world unreal.

mental_health.name: Insomnia Disorder
mental_health.desc: Can't sleep 3+ nights/week.

mental_health.name: Hypersomnia
mental_health.desc: Sleeping too much.

mental_health.name: Delayed Sleep Phase
mental_health.desc: Can't sleep before 3am.

mental_health.name: Academic Stress Disorder
mental_health.desc: School stress overwhelming.

mental_health.name: Unemployment Depression
mental_health.desc: Depression from no job.

mental_health.name: Substance-Induced Mood Disorder
mental_health.desc: Drugs cause depression/anxiety.

mental_health.name: Cultural/Spiritual Distress
mental_health.desc: Conflict with beliefs/culture.
